members.name: IHP-WINS
members.description: UNESCO's International Hydrological Programme Water Information Network System (IHP-WINS) remote catalog

catalog.name: Climate Data
catalog.description: Climate and atmospheric datasets including precipitation, temperature, and atmospheric composition from satellite missions and reanalysis products.

members.name: Global Precipitation Datasets
members.description: Global precipitation datasets including CHIRPS and PERSIANN satellite-derived rainfall estimates

members.name: Satellite Precipitation
members.description: Multi-mission precipitation products from TRMM, AMSR2, and lightning sensors for comprehensive rainfall monitoring

members.name: Temperature Analysis
members.description: Temperature datasets from NASA GIBS including AIRS, MERRA-2, and GLDAS temperature products

members.name: Atmospheric Composition
members.description: Atmospheric composition datasets including aerosols, radiation, and upper atmosphere measurements

members.name: Drought Indicators
members.description: Advanced drought monitoring combining soil moisture, vegetation, and water storage indicators

members.name: Snow & Ice Monitoring
members.description: Snow, ice, and glacier datasets for seasonal water resource assessment and cryosphere monitoring.

members.name: NASA Snow & Ice (GIBS)
members.description: Snow water equivalent and ice extent from MODIS, AMSR2, and related missions

members.name: Glaciers (GLIMS & RGI)
members.description: Global glacier outlines and inventory from GLIMS (NSIDC) and the Randolph Glacier Inventory (RGI v7.0)

members.name: Atmospheric Dynamics & Water Vapor
members.description: Atmospheric moisture transport, pressure systems, and circulation patterns affecting precipitation and water resources

members.name: Evapotranspiration & Water Cycle
members.description: Comprehensive evapotranspiration, atmospheric water vapor, and root zone soil moisture for water balance analysis and agricultural water management

members.name: Air Quality & Atmospheric Pollution
members.description: Comprehensive air quality monitoring including trace gases, aerosols, and pollutants for environmental health assessment and pollution management

catalog.name: Hydrology
catalog.description: Hydrological datasets including river networks, reservoirs, and water infrastructure supporting water resource management and analysis.

members.name: Global River Networks
members.description: Global river network dataset (HydroRIVERS) with comprehensive hydrographic information

members.name: Dams & Reservoirs Database
members.description: Global Dam Watch database with reservoir polygons organized by country

members.name: Soil Moisture
members.description: Multi-mission soil moisture products from SMAP, CYGNSS, and AMSR2 for drought monitoring and agricultural applications

members.name: Groundwater & Water Storage
members.description: GRACE mission data showing groundwater depletion and water storage changes

members.name: Flood Monitoring
members.description: Near real-time flood detection from MODIS for disaster response and emergency management

members.name: Water Quality & Ocean Color
members.description: Satellite-derived water quality indicators including chlorophyll, turbidity, and aquatic ecosystem health assessment

catalog.name: Earth Observation
catalog.description: Earth observation datasets from NASA missions providing insights into vegetation, land surface, and oceanic conditions.

members.name: Land Surface & Vegetation
members.description: GEDI canopy characteristics, MODIS vegetation indices, and land surface temperature

members.name: Fire & Vegetation Monitoring
members.description: Active fire detection, burn area mapping, and vegetation change monitoring from MODIS and VIIRS missions

members.name: Ocean Monitoring
members.description: Ocean datasets including sea surface temperature and dynamic topography

members.name: Advanced Land Surface Analysis
members.description: Land surface temperature, evapotranspiration, energy fluxes, and surface properties for hydrological applications

members.name: Land Cover & Agriculture
members.description: Global land cover classification, agricultural land mapping, and surface albedo for land use monitoring and climate studies

catalog.name: Support Layers
catalog.description: Contextual datasets including topography, demographics, and administrative boundaries providing essential background information for analysis.

members.name: Digital Elevation Models
members.description: Digital elevation models and topographic datasets for terrain analysis

members.name: Population & Demographics
members.description: Global populated places and demographic information

members.name: Political Boundaries
members.description: International and administrative boundary datasets

info.name: About This Catalog
info.content: This is a modular version of the IHP-WINS TerriaMap catalog, organized into thematic modules for better performance and maintainability. Each module contains related datasets with complete attribution and licensing information.

info.name: Data Sources
info.content: Data sources include UNESCO IHP-WINS, NASA Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), USGS/Climate Hazards Center (CHIRPS), UC Irvine (PERSIANN), McGill University/WWF (HydroRIVERS), Global Dam Watch consortium, and United Nations cartographic services.

info.name: Contact
info.content: For technical support contact earthdata-support@nasa.gov (NASA GIBS data) or consult individual dataset documentation for specific data provider contacts.
